content.text:
Recommend extracting a shared `RegistrationTimeline.svelte` and weekly aggregation helper from the member implementation. A specialized funder chart would duplicate signed-value geometry, Monday bucketing, date gaps, and missing-value handling.

- Use `RegistrationWeek { start: string; amount: string | null; incomplete: boolean }`. Keep category selection in `summarizeMember`; `summarizeFunder` includes all categories. Verify funder declaration entries are already restricted to the selected funder.
- Preserve the current exact `BigInt` decimal summation. Include known GBP values; unknown currency marks a week incomplete without contributing value. Exclude known other currencies. Missing weeks are `"0"`; weeks containing only unavailable values are `null`. Retain negatives and undated exclusion reporting.
- Give the chart a finite context prop, `"earnings" | "funding"`, with exhaustive copy selection. Avoid numerous independent label props. Use “Funding by registration week”, “No registered funding available”, and “Funding without registration dates is excluded.” Remove “Pound amounts” from the SVG description; retain `£` on amounts.
- Place pie and compact party controls in the left column, with the timeline occupying the right column. Keep recipients below. Stack the two panels below approximately 800px, matching the existing member summary.
- Replace persistent legend amounts with a shared detail popup activated by slice hover and party button hover, focus, or tap. Each party remains a button even when its amount is zero, negative, or unavailable. Its accessible name includes party, amount, entry count, and missing amount count. Support Escape dismissal and keep the popup available while its trigger or popup is hovered.
- Do not rely on SVG `<title>` for interaction. Existing native titles do not provide dependable touch or keyboard discovery. Keep the SVG labeled as a graphic and make the party buttons the complete keyboard access path.

Validation should cover exact decimal totals, signed values, empty and unavailable weeks, Sunday/Monday boundaries, undated exclusions, other currencies, zero-share parties, and keyboard/touch tooltip behavior.
